question: How to have IBM HTTP Server re-direct an application URL from HTTPS to HTTP?

We have an application which uses SSL, but we need to make this http only. We disabled all the SSL, but many clients URLs are still pointing to https. So we need a HTTP Server redirect to change these URLs from https to http. Is this possible?

required_facts.reference_quote: First, make sure the LoadModule line for mod_rewrite is uncommented in the httpd.conf
required_facts.text: First, make sure the LoadModule line for mod_rewrite is uncommented in the httpd.conf

required_facts.reference_quote: LoadModule rewrite_module modules/mod_rewrite.so
required_facts.text: LoadModule rewrite_module modules/mod_rewrite.so

required_facts.reference_quote: RewriteEngine on
required_facts.text: RewriteEngine on

required_facts.reference_quote: RewriteRule ^(.*) https://%{SERVER_NAME}%{REQUEST_URI} [R,L]
required_facts.text: RewriteRule ^(.*) https://%{SERVER_NAME}%{REQUEST_URI} [R,L]

required_facts.reference_quote: Finally, restart the IBM HTTP Server after making the preceding changes
required_facts.text: Finally, restart the IBM HTTP Server after making the preceding changes
